The post containing the target reply and the comment input form are no longer visible; instead, the main content area now displays a message stating 'You are not subscribed to any forum. Showing featured forums instead.' and lists no featured forums.

After being navigated away from the forums, the agent uses the forward button to return to the Forums index page to continue searching for the target post.

The action go_forward() navigated from the Postmill home page back to the 'List of forums' page (URL: http://localhost:9080/forums). The view now displays the full list of forum articles again, including headings such as 'AskReddit', 'relationship_advice', and 'worldnews', restoring the context where the agent can select a specific forum to find the target post.
